name: Tokuyama Corporation
summary: Tokuyama Corporation produces and sells various chemical products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Chemicals Products; Cement, Electronics Advanced Materials; Life Science; Environmental Business; and Others segments. It offers caustic soda, soda ash, calcium chloride, sodium bicarbonate and silicate, hydrogen, purified, vinyl chloride monomer, polyvinyl chloride resin, propylene oxide, chlorine-based solvents, methylene chloride for industrial use and metal washing, polyrotaxanes related products, and chloroform.
